turns.text: Hey Lloyd, the new RTX 6000 Blackwell card finally arrived. It's beastly.
Congrats on the new hardware! How is it performing so far?
Great, but I'm tweaking the vLLM launch commands. I want to make sure I don't hit OOM errors during peak inference.
That's a common concern with high-capacity cards. What models are you running?
Mostly large FP8 models. I've decided that for these 96GB cards, a recommended `--gpu-memory-utilization` setting is 0.85 to provide safer headroom. I'm locking that in.
Understood. I will note that preference for your future configurations.
Also, did you see the weather forecast for next week? Supposed to be raining all day.
I can check that for you, but it sounds like good indoor weather for coding.
True. Anyway, just keep that memory utilization rule in mind for my next script generation.
